description: Widen the review-status model from two states to three (needsReview | complete | delegated) and thread the third state through the pure data pipeline: types -> metrics -> accessMatrix -> accessGraph -> buildAccessScene. This is the data layer; it changes NO user-visible rendering yet (the node still consumes reviewStatus the same way, the edge gains a third stroke style). Dashboard metric counts must stay invariant. This feature is a prerequisite for FEAT-002 (the node/legend presentation rework consumes the widened union and the three-state edge data).
steps: src/sailpoint/types.ts: widen `export type AccessReviewStatus = 'needsReview' | 'complete'` to `'needsReview' | 'complete' | 'delegated'`. Update its JSDoc to define 'delegated' = reassigned (terminal for this reviewer) and 'complete' = a recorded keep/remove decision. Update the `reviewStatus` doc comments on AccessMatrixRowVM, AccessGraphNode, AccessGraphEdge, and AccessSceneNodeData to mention the third state and the reassigned->delegated precedence.

src/domain/metrics.ts: add `import type { AccessReviewStatus } from '../sailpoint/types'` to the existing type import line. Add a pure helper `export function reviewStatusOf(item: ReviewItemVM): AccessReviewStatus` implementing precedence: `if (item.reassigned === true) return 'delegated'; if (item.completed || item.decision != null) return 'complete'; return 'needsReview'`. Re-express `isItemReviewed` as `return reviewStatusOf(item) !== 'needsReview'` so the two helpers can never diverge; keep its JSDoc accurate (reviewed = complete OR delegated). computeMetrics behavior and counts are unchanged.

src/sailpoint/accessMatrix.ts: change the import from '../domain/metrics' to also import `reviewStatusOf` (keep isItemReviewed only if still referenced elsewhere; if not, replace it). In expandItem replace the inline `const reviewStatus: AccessReviewStatus = isItemReviewed(item) ? 'complete' : 'needsReview'` with `const reviewStatus: AccessReviewStatus = reviewStatusOf(item)`. Keep reviewStatus OUT of rowKey. In resolveMatrix's merge, keep needsReview-wins AND add the complete-vs-delegated tie rule: if existing is 'complete' and tuple is 'delegated' (or vice versa) the merged row becomes 'delegated' (reassignment is terminal); needsReview still beats both. Update the merge comment to document the three-way precedence.

src/domain/accessGraph.ts: the markStatus helper already takes `AccessReviewStatus | undefined` and does needsReview-wins. Confirm it correctly lets 'delegated' and 'complete' both apply when nothing set needsReview (it does by assignment), and update its doc comment to mention all three states and needsReview-wins. No signature change.

src/graph/buildAccessScene.ts: extend the edge styling in the edges.map so three statuses map to three strokes. needsReview -> { stroke: 'var(--vc-warn)', strokeWidth: 2, strokeDasharray: '6 4' }; complete -> { stroke: 'var(--vc-allow)', strokeWidth: 2 }; delegated -> { stroke: 'var(--vc-accent)', strokeWidth: 2, strokeDasharray: '2 3' }. Keep the `vc-graph-edge-${edge.reviewStatus}` className and `data: { reviewStatus }`. Node data.reviewStatus already passes through unchanged. Do NOT reintroduce a count badge. Update the block comment to note three states.

Adjust/extend tests (see acceptance_criteria + verification). In src/sailpoint/accessMatrix.test.ts the existing 'stamps reviewStatus + access-item identity' test currently expects the reassigned entitlement item -> 'complete'; change that expectation to 'delegated' (and its comment). Add metrics, accessGraph, and buildAccessScene cases for the delegated path.
acceptance_criteria: reviewStatusOf returns 'delegated' for reassigned (even when also completed/decided), 'complete' for completed-or-decided-not-reassigned, 'needsReview' otherwise; isItemReviewed is true for both complete and delegated and false for needsReview.

accessMatrix: a reassigned item maps to reviewStatus 'delegated'; a decided item 'complete'; an undecided item 'needsReview'. reviewStatus is excluded from dedup (row count + ids invariant vs the undecided worked example). needsReview-wins on collision; complete-vs-delegated collision resolves to 'delegated'.

accessGraph: a 'delegated' row stamps reviewStatus onto the user's direct access-item node and the user->item edge only; deeper nodes/edges and the user/source nodes stay undefined. Existing needsReview-wins and complete behavior unchanged.

buildAccessScene: a 'delegated' user->item edge has className containing 'vc-graph-edge-delegated', data.reviewStatus 'delegated', style.stroke 'var(--vc-accent)', and a dotted strokeDasharray; needsReview/complete edge styles and node data.reviewStatus passthrough unchanged; no count badge.
Dashboard metric counts unchanged (CampaignDashboard.test.ts / metrics.test.ts reassigned-as-reviewed cases still pass).
verification: npx vitest run src/domain/metrics.test.ts src/sailpoint/accessMatrix.test.ts src/domain/accessGraph.test.ts src/graph/buildAccessScene.test.ts  (all green, including the new delegated cases)
npm run build  (zero type errors; confirm no non-exhaustive switch/map over the widened union)
findings:
DONE & GREEN (4 target files: 63 tests; full suite: 31 files / 225 tests; npm run build + npm run lint clean). Handoff for FEAT-002:
- AccessReviewStatus union (src/sailpoint/types.ts) is now exactly: 'needsReview' | 'complete' | 'delegated'. Precedence: reassigned -> 'delegated' (terminal), else completed||decision!=null -> 'complete', else 'needsReview'.
- reviewStatusOf(item: ReviewItemVM): AccessReviewStatus lives in src/domain/metrics.ts (exported, pure); isItemReviewed is now `reviewStatusOf(item) !== 'needsReview'`. accessMatrix.ts imports reviewStatusOf (no longer isItemReviewed). resolveMatrix merge precedence: needsReview-wins, else complete-vs-delegated tie -> 'delegated'.
- Edge className scheme (buildAccessScene.ts): status edges get `vc-graph-edge-status vc-graph-edge-<status>` (e.g. vc-graph-edge-delegated), plus data.reviewStatus and a style via the new local edgeStyle() switch: needsReview -> var(--vc-warn) dashed '6 4'; complete -> var(--vc-allow) solid; delegated -> var(--vc-accent) dotted '2 3'. Node data.reviewStatus still passes through; no count badge.
- IMPORTANT for FEAT-002: AccessNode.tsx currently still renders the OLD StatusChip (text chip). To unblock the FEAT-001 build I only widened StatusChip's prop type to AccessReviewStatus and added STATUS_CHIP_LABEL.delegated='Reassigned' (Record<AccessReviewStatus,string>). FEAT-002 should REMOVE StatusChip/STATUS_CHIP_LABEL and the .vc-graph-status-chip* CSS and replace with the corner StatusIcon (shape-differentiated per status, lower-right) + render label+kind caption, and grow the legend (AccessGraphCanvas.tsx) from 2 to 3 entries. There is no new CSS rule yet for .vc-graph-card-status-delegated or .vc-graph-edge-delegated — FEAT-002 must add them (use --vc-accent to match the MetricCard reassign precedent).
- markStatus in src/domain/accessGraph.ts is unchanged in signature; needsReview-wins, and 'complete'/'delegated' both apply by assignment when nothing set needsReview (matrix resolves complete-vs-delegated upstream). Status is stamped only on levels[1] (first hop off user) node + the user->item edge.
- Dashboard metric counts unchanged (reassigned still counted as reviewed, never approved/revoked).
